form.lead: Fill in the details from your e-mail provider. You can usually find them in the provider's help pages about IMAP.

hint.display_name: A name you recognise, for example Work or Personal.
hint.account_id_new: The account gets a short name, made from the account name when you save. The short name is used in the AI tool to tell the accounts apart.

hint.imap_port: Usually 993 for SSL/TLS and 143 for STARTTLS.
hint.username: Usually your e-mail address. Leave empty if it is the same as the e-mail address.
hint.password_new: The password is stored in the computer's keychain, never in the settings file.

hint.password_none: No password is stored for this account yet.
hint.password_provider: Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com no longer accept passwords for IMAP. They require signing in with OAuth, which is not supported yet. Gmail, iCloud and Fastmail require an app password, which you create in the account's security settings.
hint.password_again: For security, a password you typed is not kept when the form has errors. Type it again.
smtp.intro: Only needed if the AI tool may send mail directly. Drafts are saved over IMAP.
hint.smtp_port: Usually 465 for SSL/TLS and 587 for STARTTLS.
hint.smtp_username: Leave empty to use the same user name as for IMAP.
hint.smtp_password: Leave empty to use the same password as for IMAP.
hint.smtp_password_keep: A separate SMTP password is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it.
folders.intro: Leave the fields empty to find the folders automatically. Only fill them in if the wrong folder is found.
hint.folder: The folder name on the server, for example Sent Items.
save_sent.auto_hint: Saves a copy in the Sent folder, except when the server does it itself, as Gmail does.
save_sent.always_hint: Always saves a copy in the Sent folder.
save_sent.never_hint: Saves no copy. Choose this if the server always saves sent mail itself.
fs.read_marking: When should mail be marked as read?
read_marking.never: Never – nothing is marked as read by this connector (recommended)
read_marking.never_hint: What the AI tool reads is never marked as read, and neither is what you open yourself.
read_marking.user_open: When I open a message myself in the side panel
read_marking.user_open_hint: Applies only when you read in the mailbox panel in your AI tool. What the AI tool reads is still never marked as read.
fs.permissions: What may the AI tool do?
permissions.intro: The AI tool can always read the mail in the account. Here you choose what else it may do.
field.organise: Organise: flag, mark as read or unread, move, copy and put in the trash
send_mode.drafts: Save drafts only – you send them yourself
send_mode.warning: Text in an e-mail you have received can try to make the AI tool send mail. If the tool may both read and send, it can be tricked into sending mail you did not ask for. Saving drafts only is therefore the safer choice.

hint.save_attachments: Attachments are saved in the attachments folder, in subfolders for account, year and month: account/year/month/dokument or account/year/month/karantän (quarantine). Attachments in mail from the junk folder and risky file types, such as programs and Office files with macros, always go to karantän. hint.knowledge_intro: A knowledge base is a file of common questions and answers for the account. The AI tool uses it when it suggests replies to mail. The connector never sends anything by itself.
hint.knowledge_format_title: What the file should look like
hint.knowledge_format_text: The file is a plain Markdown text file, saved as UTF-8 and at most 1 MB. Each question starts with ## on a line of its own, and the answer is on the lines below. A line starting with Keywords: right below the question gives more words that should match. At the top you can give tone, signature and other instructions between two lines of ---.
hint.knowledge_example:
---
tone: friendly and brief
signature: The board, Example Society
---

## How do I become a member?
Keywords: membership, join, sign up
Fill in the form on our website.

## How much is the membership fee?
300 kronor a year. <!-- Probably goes up next year, do not mention it yet. -->
hint.knowledge_comments: Text between <!-- and --> is notes for you and others who edit the file. The notes are removed when the file is read and never reach the AI tool.
hint.knowledge_meta_none: The file sets no tone, signature or other instructions.

mailbox.kb_suggest: Suggest a reply from the knowledge base
mailbox.kb_suggest_text: Suggest a reply to a message in my email: “{subject}” in the account {account}, folder {folder} (uid {uid}, uidvalidity {uidvalidity}). Read the message with imap_get_message and look up matching answers in the knowledge base with imap_knowledge_search. Then save a draft reply with imap_reply (mode draft) in the knowledge base's tone and with its signature. If nothing in the knowledge base matches, say so instead of making up an answer. Answer me in English. Write the draft in plain language as running prose, the way you would speak: short, clear sentences, and lists only where they genuinely help, even if the knowledge base is written as bullet points. Then open the draft with imap_open_mailbox so that I can read and change it.

mailbox.compose_old_draft_trashed: The old draft is in the trash.
mailbox.compose_old_draft_kept: The old draft is still in {folder}.
mailbox.compose_draft_replyto: The draft is addressed to the address the message asked for. Check the recipients before you send it.
mailbox.compose_replyto_refused: The reply was not sent, because a recipient is the address the message asked for, and it has a different domain from the sender. Save the reply as a draft or change the recipient.
mailbox.compose_error_save: The draft could not be saved. {detail}
mailbox.compose_error_send: The message could not be sent. {detail}
mailbox.compose_errors_heading: There are problems in the form
mailbox.compose_error_no_recipient: Enter at least one recipient under To, Cc or Bcc.
mailbox.compose_error_address: “{address}” does not look like an e-mail address. Write it like name@example.com.
mailbox.compose_error_server_address: The server did not accept the address “{address}”.
mailbox.compose_confirm_title: Do you want to discard what you have written?
mailbox.compose_confirm_text: What you have written is not saved.
mailbox.compose_kept_text: The quotation is not changed and is added below your text when you save or send.
mailbox.compose_format_note.reply_html: The reply is sent formatted, in the same format as the message you reply to.
mailbox.compose_format_note.reply_text: The reply is sent as plain text, in the same format as the message you reply to.
mailbox.compose_format_note.forward_html: The message is sent formatted, in the same format as the one you forward.
mailbox.compose_format_note.forward_text: The message is sent as plain text, in the same format as the one you forward.
mailbox.editor_hint: Shortcuts: Cmd or Ctrl + B for bold, I for italic, U for underline and K for a link. In the row of formatting buttons, move between the buttons with the arrow keys.
mailbox.link_url_hint: Starts with https://, http:// or mailto:
mailbox.link_error: Enter an address that starts with https://, http:// or mailto:
send.ask: Send mail from the account {name} to {to} with the subject “{subject}”?
send.ask_window: You can also choose not to be asked again for {minutes} minutes.
mailbox.compose_gate: Read the whole text. The Send button can be pressed once you have scrolled to the end of the text.
mailbox.compose_gate_ready: You have read the whole text. You can send now.
mailbox.link_failed: The link could not be opened. The address is {url}
mailbox.ext_blocked_images: Images and layout from the internet are not shown. Loading them can tell the sender that you have opened the message.
mailbox.ext_blocked: The sender's layout is not shown. Only show it if you trust the sender.
mailbox.ext_loaded_once: Images and layout are shown for this message.
mailbox.ext_trusted_sender: Images and layout are shown because you trust {sender}.
mailbox.ext_trusted_domain: Images and layout are shown because you trust everything from {domain}.
mailbox.ext_done: The message is shown with images and layout.
mailbox.ext_trusted_done: Content from {value} is now always shown.
mailbox.ext_untrusted_done: Content from {value} is no longer shown automatically.
mailbox.ext_trust_failed: The list could not be changed: {detail}
trusted.heading: Show images and layout automatically
trusted.intro: From these senders and domains, images and layout are shown without asking. You add them here or from a message in the mailbox.
trusted.add_hint: Enter an e-mail address, for example news@example.com, or a domain, for example example.com. A domain covers every sender there.
trusted.add_hint_tracking: Loading images tells the sender that you have opened the message.
error.trusted_value: Enter an e-mail address or a domain, for example news@example.com or example.com.
flash.trust_added: {name} has been added. Images and layout from there are now shown automatically.
mailbox.ext_trust_browser: The settings page opened in the browser. Add {value} there, under the account and the heading Show images and layout automatically.
mailbox.ext_trust_browser_manual: Senders that should always be shown are added on the settings page, under the account and the heading Show images and layout automatically. Add {value} there.
flash.trust_removed: {name} has been removed. Images from there are no longer shown automatically.
settingspanel.trusted.none: From no sender yet. You add senders from a message in the mailbox.
settingspanel.trusted.removed: {value} has been removed. Images from there are no longer shown automatically.
mailbox.ext_unverified_sender: You trust {sender}, but your mail server could not confirm that the message really comes from there. So images are not shown automatically.
mailbox.ext_unverified_domain: You trust everything from {domain}, but your mail server could not confirm that the message really comes from there. So images are not shown automatically.
mailbox.unreachable: The mail server {host} does not answer. The network may be down, or a VPN, firewall or security program may be blocking mail (port {port}). Other mail programs on this computer are probably affected too.
settingspanel.unreachable: The mail server {host} does not answer. The network may be down, or a VPN, firewall or security program may be blocking mail (port {port}). Other mail programs on this computer are probably affected too.
mailbox.server_not_found: No mail server is called {host}. Check the spelling of the server name in the settings. If it is right, the network or its name server may be down.
settingspanel.server_not_found: No mail server is called {host}. Check the spelling of the server name in the settings. If it is right, the network or its name server may be down.
